# Hoffer & Sheremet, PLC

> Female-owned medical malpractice law firm in Grand Rapids, Michigan specializing in birth injury cases and delivering aggressive trial representation for families.

Hoffer & Sheremet, PLC is a medical malpractice firm founded by attorneys Stephanie Hoffer and Aubri Sheremet, serving West Michigan with a particular focus on birth injury litigation. The firm handles cases involving hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE), cerebral palsy, Erb's palsy, and other delivery-related injuries across Michigan counties including Kent, Grand Traverse, and Ingham.
